otaAssignments.title: Store / device overrides
otaAssignments.description: Overrides take precedence over the global baseline above. Priority: device > store > baseline (the first matching layer wins). An expired override falls back to the next layer automatically.
otaAssignments.loadFailed: Failed to load store / device overrides
otaAssignments.empty: No overrides yet. Every device follows the global baseline.
otaAssignments.releasesUnavailable: The OTA release list failed to load, so overrides cannot be added or edited for now. Refresh the release list above first.
otaAssignments.deleteConfirmDescription: After deletion, "{{target}}" falls back to the next layer (store or global baseline).

form.targetImmutable: The target cannot be changed after creation. To change it, delete this override and add a new one.
form.deviceStoreHelp: Pick a store first, then pick a device under it. Leave empty to list all iPad devices.
form.selectDevice: Search by device number / remarks and select
form.releaseRuntimeHint: Only registered releases whose runtime matches the global baseline ({{runtime}}) are listed.
form.releaseRuntimeUnknown: The global baseline has no release, so releases cannot be filtered by runtime. All registered releases are listed; make sure the runtime matches the target devices.
form.releaseMessagePlaceholder: Tell the client what this update contains
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. pilot store, problem device verification
form.expiresAtHelp: Leave empty for no expiry. After expiry the override stops applying and falls back to the next layer.
form.expiresAtInvalid: An enabled override must expire in the future

message.versionConflict: This override was changed by someone else and the list has been refreshed. Your change was not replayed; review and try again.
message.versionConflictReloadFailed: This override was changed by someone else, but refreshing the list failed. Refresh manually and review.
message.targetExists: This target already has an enabled override. Edit the existing one, or disable / delete it first.
message.notFound: This override no longer exists or was deleted. The list has been refreshed.
message.expiresInvalid: The expiry time must be in the future
message.releaseInvalid: The selected OTA release does not exist. Refresh the release list and pick again.
message.messageTooLong: The release message cannot exceed 1000 characters
message.targetInvalid: Invalid target store / device (the store must be active and the device an enabled iPad)
